Looking at the failing tests, I need to implement `get_bounds` for both `GPXTrackSegment` and `GPXTrack` classes.

The issue in `GPXTrackSegment.get_bounds()` is the condition `if min_lat and max_lat and min_lon and max_lon:` which fails when values are 0 or negative (falsy). It should check `if min_lat is not None`.

The `GPXTrack.get_bounds()` is currently returning `pass` (None).
